Question
========
According to the theory of skill-biased technological change, why does inequality rise?

Answerlist
----------
* Technology raises demand for highly skilled workers faster than education supplies them
* Trade unions demand too high wages
* Governments tax capital too heavily
* Profits are spent on share buybacks

Solution
========
When skill supply does not keep pace with technology, the wage gap between skilled and less skilled workers grows.

Answerlist
----------
* True
* False
* False
* False
